subject.title: fix(signal): add timeouts to container REST requests

question: Should the existing Signal request timeout intentionally govern both the wait for response headers and the maximum idle gap between response-body chunks?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but broadening an existing timeout's operational meaning is a compatibility choice for callers that supply short values.

options.title: Accept progress-aware semantics
options.body: Merge after exact-head gates with the existing timeout covering header wait and inter-chunk body idle time.

options.title: Separate body-idle timing
options.body: Revise the patch to use a distinct internal body-idle duration if short header deadlines must permit longer transfer pauses.

recommendation.title: Accept progress-aware semantics
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head gates with the existing timeout covering header wait and inter-chunk body idle time.
